title: Computing Homomorphisms of Poset Representations with Applications to Multiparameter Persistence
summary: We present algorithms to compute the vector space of homomorphisms Hom(X,Y) between finitely generated representations of the partially ordered set Z^d. Our results generalise to any partially ordered set. Our main theoretical contribution is a uniqueness result for lifts of homomorphisms along free resolutions, which we use to obtain an algorithm running in O(n^4 (thick(Y) + thick(Omega^1 Y))^2 + T_ker(d,n)) time, where thick(Y) denotes the maximal pointwise dimension of Y and T_ker is the time it takes to compute the kernel of a map between projective Z^d-modules.
